items:
A work permit 
 must be issued.

The qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable ID safety category.

Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 helmet, shoes, breathing-mask, safety glasses ... etc.
Close the main pulsing valve
Shutdown the compressor before replacing the oil
Suitable tool set
Vacuum cleaner or blower
Equipments for oil filing
Cleaning clothes
Monitoring of DP across each filter stage.
Check leakage of double diaphragm valves.

Inspection on weather entry screen for blockage of 
 debris.

Inspection of filter elements for fastening outer 
 damages, contamination and alignment to frame.
Inspection of drainage lines for damages and corrosion.

Inspection of all flange connections for outer damage, 
 tightness, and completeness of bolted joints.

Inspection of doors at filter house for closing devices 
 and sealing.

Visible check of clean compressor inlet via MBL 
 inspection windows.
Change the filters according to DP.
Check cleanness

Change the oil and the oil filter for the pulse 
 compressor.
Change the air filter for the pulse compressor.
Replace oil separator for the pulse compressor.
Test safety valve.
Test auto drain function for compressor and dryers.
Filter check and connections check for air dryer.

Leakage check on hoses, hose connection and container 
 for oil water separator
Check condensate level at sight glass for DD/PD filters.
Test auto drain function for DD/PD filters.
Test auto drain function for air receiver.

Introduction

8000 hr bases as indicated by W1 in the title block for air intake, cleaning air 
added to fuel and burnt in combustion chamber and hot gases are expanded in 
turbine.
